The '''Alderaanian Embassy''' was the official representation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Alderaan consular gardens]] were attached to the embassy, and its household staff was led by a [[Alderaan consulate chief|chief]].
